done_when: docs/start.md tells Claude, in plain steps for Mac and Windows, how to install only what notes, the brief and the design need, sign the person in to GitHub, and create a private repo in the named company GitHub. The shipped guide tells every agent to lead in plain words with the next step, also after a break, to write a plain message for the named developer when it cannot recover, and to write a handover summary after client sign-off. forge next shows no sign-off question list until the repo has a client note or a brief with content, on new repos and on repos adopted earlier.
why: A salesperson or FDE with little Claude Code experience cannot start alone: nothing tells Claude how to set them up, guide them in plain words, or hand over to a developer, and forge next lists 7 sign-off questions before they have shared an idea.
